issue.title: Record the decision that Highlights-bound PDFs render on pandoc + xelatex with the text-layer rule

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Proposed by bob-cli-87.12 note #19 (bob-cli-87 land agent triage). Add a decisions-web strand, working name `annotated-pdfs-render-on-xelatex`, via /sase_memory_write and then run `sase memory init`:

- Claim: Highlights-bound PDFs that bob renders, both note snapshots (`bob ref create <vault note>`) and research-report Markdown, use pandoc + xelatex with the text-layer rule (ragged-right, no hyphenation, `Ligatures=NoCommon`, zero Type 3 body fonts) and never Chromium/Skia with variable fonts. Note snapshots are dated reading projections, not prints.
- Why: the PDFKit and real-quote measurements in research:202610/area_project_note_reading_pdfs (Chromium Type 3 variable-font embedding damaged 2.4-6.4% of PDFKit words; xelatex read back clean), plus the 2026-10-17 Mac PDFKit corpus probe (101/101 snapshots, 0 unexplained words).
- Rejected alternatives: Chromium; Typst now (recorded runner-up for a future engine-wide migration); Lua-side Bob parsing (Rust owns the semantics).
- Reopens when: the TeX long tail keeps tripping the corpus gate; bulk or automated snapshots; color emoji.
- Evidence: plan:202610/note_snapshots.md and the bob-cli-87 commits.

The bob-cli-87 plan explicitly kept this out of that epic (decision_record = no), so closing this task still needs Bryan's explicit approval of the memory edit.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-87.12 note #19 proposed this decisions-web record; the bob-cli-87 reviewer chose decision_record = no for that epic, so no memory was edited there. Bryan should decide separately whether to record it.
